name: Cinex
summary: **Cinex** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Elev8 Seeds|Elev8 Seeds]], a cross of a pineapple phenotype of [[cinderella-99|Cinderella 99]] and [[vortex|Vortex]]. It descends from a clone-only cut that circulated in the Pacific Northwest of the [[country:US|United States]] before Elev8 reworked it into a seed line for wider release.

sources.title: Cinex
sources.note: Breeder-submitted genetics (Cinderella 99 pineapple pheno x Vortex), flowering time, and history as a Pacific Northwest clone-only cut before Elev8 Seeds' seed release.
